catalog_policy: Do not add public-file-catalog rows until this file exists on a published Zenodo record.
public_note: This small workflow/source-quality audit package records a Gibbs and Gauss source-baseline sweep. It is methodology and source-intake evidence, not a reader edition or a new transcription tranche.

targets.quality_label: Workflow/source-quality audit packet for Gibbs and Gauss source baselines
targets.coverage: The package contains audit notes, source-quality status tables, local inventory CSVs, Internet Archive/GDZ metadata captures, source-quality probes, and session notes for J. Willard Gibbs and Carl Friedrich Gauss. The Gibbs audit identifies IA raw JP2/scandata packages for Scientific Papers Vols. I-II and a separate processed-JP2/PDF witness for On the Equilibrium of Heterogeneous Substances. The Gauss audit identifies a coherent GDZ Werke baseline for Bands I-XII using source PDFs plus IIIF manifests, and records IA/Gallica candidates as optional comparators.
targets.limitations: This is a workflow/source-intake package only. It does not upload the large raw JP2/GDZ source files themselves, does not extend any reader coverage, does not certify existing Gauss/Gibbs TeX, and does not turn OCR or derivative PDFs into authority. It should be cited as a source-baseline decision and reproducibility note.
targets.next_action: Upload with the next workflow/replication Zenodo refresh, update workflow metadata and record pages, and keep the actual large Gibbs/Gauss source scans in their author/source folders or the raw provenance record as appropriate.
